traits.name: Source
traits.text: tales from the yawning portal,  page 244

traits.name: Undead Nature
traits.text: A lich doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

traits.name: Focused Conjuration
traits.text: While Var is concentrating on a conjuration spell, his concentration can't be broken as a result of taking damage.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/Day)
traits.text: If Var fails a saving throw, he can choose to succeed instead .

traits.name: Rejuvenation
traits.text: If Var is destroyed but his phylactery remains intact, Var gains a new body in ldlO days, regaining all his hit points and becoming active again. The new body appears within 5 feet of the phylactery.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.text: Var is a 12th-level spellcaster. His spellcasting ability is Intelligence (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks). He has the following wizard spells prepared: * Cantrips (at will): fire bolt, mage hand, minor illusion, prestidigitation, ray of frost * 1st level (4 slots): detect magic, magic missile, shield, unseen servant\* * 2nd level (3 slots): detect thoughts, flaming sphere\*, mirror image, scorching ray * 3rd level (3 slots): counterspell, dispel magic, fireball * 4th level (3 slots): dimension door\*, Evard's black tentacles\* * 5th level (3 slots): cloudkill\*, scrying * 6th level (1 slot): circle of death *Conjuration spell of 1st level or higher.

traits.name: Turn Resistance
traits.text: Var has advantage on saving throws against any effect that turns undead .

actions.name: Paralyzing Touch
actions.text: Melee Spell Attack: +9 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 10 (3d6) cold damage. The target must succeed on a DC 17 Constitution saving throw or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

actions.name: Benign Transposition
actions.text: Var teleports up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space he can see. Alternatively, he can choose a space within range that is occupied by a Small or Medium creature. If that creature is willing, both creatures teleport, swapping places. Var can use this feature again only after he finishes a long rest or casts a conjuration spell of 1st level or higher.
